name: glob
description: Find files by name pattern (e.g. '**/*.rs', 'src/**/test_*.py'). Returns paths relative to the workspace root, most recently modified first. Use this to locate files when you know part of the name or extension; use 'grep' when you know what is inside them.

pattern.description: Glob pattern matched against paths relative to the search root. '**' crosses directories, '*' does not.

path.description: Directory to search under, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the workspace root.
